---
title: Remote Work Policy
effective_date: 2024-03-15
---

# Eligibility

All full-time employees are eligible after 90 days of employment.

## Hybrid schedule

Employees may work remotely up to three days per week.

Here is an example config used by the automation:

```python
# this hash should NOT be treated as a heading
def is_eligible(tenure_days):
    return tenure_days >= 90
```

# Termination

Either party may end the arrangement with two weeks notice.
